name: wds_voc2007_multilabel
description: wds_voc2007_multilabel is a multi-label image classification benchmark derived from the PASCAL VOC 2007 labels, intended to evaluate models' ability to detect multiple object classes per image. It measures how well vision models predict all relevant object categories present in an image rather than a single primary label. The dataset is commonly used for benchmarking multi-label recognition and retrieval approaches.
reputation: Derived from the well-known PASCAL VOC 2007 benchmark and widely used as a standard multi-label evaluation set in vision research.
